complete_chinese: 当然。有些公园离我太远，希望家附近就有漂亮的公园和花园。

sentences.explanation: “of course” 表示“当然”，用于直接、肯定地回应 Would you like... 这类征求意见的问句，语气比单纯的 “Yes” 更热情、更确定。
sentences.usage: 在口语考试中，如果想加强语气，还可以说 “Yes, definitely.” 或 “Absolutely.”；但 “Yes, of course.” 已经是非常自然、地道的回答。

sentences.en: Some parks are really remote from me — there's a big distance.
sentences.explanation: “remote from” 表示“离……遥远”，相当于 “far from”；破折号后的 “there's a big distance” 是对前一句的补充说明，强调空间距离大，但日常口语中这样说略显重复。
sentences.usage: 描述公园、商店等离家远，更常用的说法是 “Some parks are quite far from where I live.” 或 “It takes me a long time to get to some parks.”；如果想表达“不在步行范围内”，可以说 “They're not within walking distance.”

sentences.zh: 希望家附近就有漂亮的公园和花园。
sentences.en: So I hope there will be more beautiful gardens and parks close to where I live.
sentences.explanation: “there will be” 是 there be 句型的一般将来时，表示“将会有”；“close to where I live” 意为“离我住的地方近”，比 “near my home” 更口语化，且 “close to” 后可以直接接宾语从句。
sentences.usage: “hope (that) + 从句” 表示希望发生某事；描述地点近，还可以说 “within walking distance”, “just around the corner from my place” 或 “in my neighborhood.”
